items.label: TURRICAN II/3532
items.why: Boot depacker reaches story entry $7B3D after the drive upload. Story/pictures/music are listed in intro; $A818-$AB17 and $C000-$C377 are host/drive-loader material, and the remaining unpacked gap is zero padding.
Resident engine expands to $0400-$67FF; the loader at intro source $9061 asks for the two-dot name.
Title/score display expands to $6C00-$B937, selected by intro source $9099 and resident $5444.

items.label: raw high-score sector
items.why: Title $900C/$9013 writes one block at track 18/sector 18 from $67FF; intro loading source $90A2/$90A9 reads the same block. It contains a prefix byte, ten 25-byte score/name/level records and five trailing zeros. The BAM marks this slot free; it was added from the traced raw-sector calls rather than the allocated-sector scan.
